legend: It's another Start[c]up finals, and that means there is pizza to order for the onsite contestants. There are only 2 types of pizza (obviously not, but let's just pretend for the sake of the problem), and all pizzas contain exactly S slices.

It is known that the i-th contestant will eat si slices of pizza, and gain ai happiness for each slice of type 1 pizza they eat, and bi happiness for each slice of type 2 pizza they eat. We can order any number of type 1 and type 2 pizzas, but we want to buy the minimum possible number of pizzas for all of the contestants to be able to eat their required number of slices. Given that restriction, what is the maximum possible total happiness that can be achieved?
input: The first line of input will contain integers N and S (1 ≤ N ≤ 105, 1 ≤ S ≤ 105), the number of contestants and the number of slices per pizza, respectively. N lines follow.

The i-th such line contains integers si, ai, and bi (1 ≤ si ≤ 105, 1 ≤ ai ≤ 105, 1 ≤ bi ≤ 105), the number of slices the i-th contestant will eat, the happiness they will gain from each type 1 slice they eat, and the happiness they will gain from each type 2 slice they eat, respectively.
output: Print the maximum total happiness that can be achieved.
note: In the first example, you only need to buy one pizza. If you buy a type 1 pizza, the total happiness will be 3·5 + 4·6 + 5·9 = 84, and if you buy a type 2 pizza, the total happiness will be 3·7 + 4·7 + 5·5 = 74.

legend.ai: 又到了 Start[c]up 决赛，这意味着需要为现场参赛者订购披萨。披萨只有 2 种类型（显然不止两种，但为了这道题，我们姑且这么假设），并且所有披萨都恰好包含 S 片。
已知第 i 位参赛者将食用 si 片披萨，并且每食用一片 1 型披萨可获得 ai 的幸福值，每食用一片 2 型披萨可获得 bi 的幸福值。我们可以订购任意数量的 1 型和 2 型披萨，但希望为所有参赛者购买尽可能少的披萨，使他们都能吃到所需数量的披萨片。在满足这一限制的前提下，能够获得的总幸福值最大是多少？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 N 和 S（1 ≤ N ≤ 105，1 ≤ S ≤ 105），分别表示参赛者数量和每个披萨包含的披萨片数量。接下来有 N 行。
其中第 i 行包含整数 si、ai 和 bi（1 ≤ si ≤ 105，1 ≤ ai ≤ 105，1 ≤ bi ≤ 105），分别表示第 i 位参赛者将食用的披萨片数量、他们每食用一片 1 型披萨片所获得的幸福值，以及他们每食用一片 2 型披萨片所获得的幸福值。

output.ai: 输出能够获得的最大总幸福值。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，你只需要购买一个披萨。如果购买 1 型披萨，总幸福值为 3·5 + 4·6 + 5·9 = 84；如果购买 2 型披萨，总幸福值为 3·7 + 4·7 + 5·5 = 74。
